AdCP Integration ​

AdCP (Ad Context Protocol) handles media buying. AdRail handles payments.

"AdCP handles media buying, AdRail handles the money."

Overview ​

AdRail provides full integration with AdCP, allowing you to:

  • Connect escrows to AdCP campaigns for automatic payment
  • Auto-record impressions from AdCP webhook events
  • Track delivery across both platforms in one view
  • Settle payments automatically when ads are served
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        AdCP Layer                           │
│  • Ad request/response                                      │
│  • Targeting & context                                      │
│  • Creative delivery                                        │
│  • Delivery reporting                                       │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
                              ↓ Webhook Events
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                       AdRail Layer                          │
│  • Escrow management                                        │
│  • Auto-impression recording                                │
│  • USDC settlement                                          │

└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘

Quick Start ​

1. Create and Fund an Escrow ​

bash
# Create escrow
curl -X POST https://api.adrail.ai/v1/escrows \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ak_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"amount_usdc": 1000}'

# Fund it (send USDC, then confirm)
curl -X POST https://api.adrail.ai/v1/escrows/esc_abc123/fund \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ak_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"tx_hash": "0x..."}'

# Activate
curl -X POST https://api.adrail.ai/v1/escrows/esc_abc123/activate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ak_xxx"

2. Connect to AdCP Agent ​

bash
curl -X POST https://api.adrail.ai/v1/adcp/connect \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ak_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "escrow_id": "esc_abc123",
    "adcp_agent_url": "https://ads.example.com",
    "auto_record_impressions": true,
    "auto_settle": true,
    "media_buy_config": {
      "buyer_ref": "my_campaign_q1",
      "packages": [{"package_id": "premium_video"}],
      "total_budget": 1000,
      "currency": "USD"
    }
  }'

Response:

json
{
  "id": "adcp_abc123",
  "escrow_id": "esc_abc123",
  "agent_url": "https://ads.example.com",
  "agent_name": "Example Ad Network",
  "media_buy_id": "mb_xyz789",
  "status": "connected",
  "webhook_url": "https://api.adrail.ai/v1/adcp/webhook/events/adcp_abc123",
  "webhook_secret": "whsec_xxx"
}

3. Monitor Delivery & Payments ​

bash
# Get combined delivery + payment status
curl https://api.adrail.ai/v1/adcp/delivery/adcp_abc123 \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ak_xxx"
json
{
  "connection_id": "adcp_abc123",
  "status": "connected",
  "adrail": {
    "escrow_balance_usdc": 750,
    "total_spend_usdc": 250,
    "impressions_recorded": 25000,
    "escrow_status": "active"
  },
  "adcp": {
    "impressions": 25000,
    "clicks": 450,
    "spend": 250,
    "cpm_effective": 10,
    "viewability_rate": 0.85
  }
}

How It Works ​

Connection Flow ​

1. Advertiser creates escrow → AdRail
2. Advertiser connects escrow to AdCP agent → AdRail + AdCP
3. AdRail discovers agent capabilities (A2A/MCP)
4. AdRail creates media buy on AdCP agent
5. AdCP sends webhook URL to agent
6. Ads start serving...

Automatic Impression Recording ​

When auto_record_impressions: true:

  1. AdCP agent sends impression events to AdRail webhook
  2. AdRail validates the event signature
  3. AdRail records impression against escrow
  4. Escrow balance is deducted
  5. Publisher earnings accumulate

Manual Impression Recording ​

If you prefer manual control, set auto_record_impressions: false:

bash
curl -X POST https://api.adrail.ai/v1/impressions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer pk_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "escrow_id": "esc_abc123",
    "count": 1000,
    "cpm_usdc": 10,
    "adcp_request_id": "adcp_req_xyz789"
  }'

API Endpoints ​

EndpointMethodDescription
/v1/adcp/connectPOSTLink escrow to AdCP campaign
/v1/adcp/campaignsGETList all AdCP connections
/v1/adcp/delivery/:idGETGet delivery + payment status
/v1/adcp/webhook/:type/:idPOSTReceive AdCP webhook events
/v1/adcp/events/:idGETGet event history
/v1/adcp/connect/:idDELETEDisconnect from AdCP

Webhook Events ​

AdRail automatically processes these AdCP webhook events:

Event TypeAction
impressionRecord impression, deduct from escrow
media_buy.completedUpdate connection status
media_buy.input-requiredMark as pending approval
delivery_updateSync delivery metrics

Webhook Security ​

All webhooks are signed using HMAC-SHA256. Configure your agent to send:

x-adcp-signature: sha256=<hmac>
x-adcp-timestamp: <iso8601>

Verify using the webhook_secret returned when connecting.

Protocol Support ​

AdRail supports both AdCP transport protocols:

MCP (Model Context Protocol) ​

  • Direct tool calls to AdCP agents
  • Ideal for Claude and MCP-compatible AI systems
  • Simpler integration

A2A (Agent-to-Agent) ​

  • Full multi-modal message support
  • SSE streaming for real-time updates
  • Complex agent workflows

AdRail auto-detects the protocol from the agent's well-known endpoints:

  • /.well-known/agent.json → A2A
  • /.well-known/mcp.json → MCP

Error Handling ​

Connection Errors ​

json
{
  "error": "AdCP agent error",
  "details": [
    {"code": "AGENT_UNREACHABLE", "message": "Cannot connect to agent"}
  ]
}

Insufficient Balance ​

If impressions exceed escrow balance, they're rejected:

json
{
  "error": "Insufficient balance for impression",
  "escrow_balance_usdc": 5,
  "required_usdc": 10
}

Human Approval Required ​

Some AdCP operations require approval:

json
{
  "status": "pending_approval",
  "message": "Budget exceeds $50K - requires VP approval"
}

Best Practices ​

  1. Use auto-recording for hands-off operation
  2. Monitor escrow balance to avoid campaign pauses
  3. Set up alerting on low balance events
  4. Verify webhook signatures in production
  5. Link adcp_request_id for full audit trail

AAO Membership ​

AdRail is integrating with the Agentic Advertising Organization (AAO), the industry body behind AdCP.

Benefits:

  • Listed in AdCP publisher/buyer directories
  • Access to AdCP signal data
  • Standardized integration patterns
